issues.reason: The quoted proposition is wholly negative, and the instruction set's registered limitation is explicit that a seal with no polarity carrier means "seal what is expressible and leave the negated conjunct out; this is a registered limitation, not a licence to assert the positive form" — the parse records the opposite of what the speaker said.

"I don't even worry" is a simple present, and the status rules say to read the marker off the clause — a bare simple present takes no status atom at all, so (Past sk_worry_1) is a tense the clause does not mark.

Cessation needs a same-symbol Past plus a strength-0 denial, and neither half can exist inside a seal (a sealed term carries no truth value), so leaving "anymore" untraced is what the registered limitation prescribes — this is the coverage gap the reviewer itself files, not a parse defect.
A demonstrative "that" is definite, and definite referents inside a seal project their typing atom to top level "in every sealing construct alike".

A top-level focus atom anchored on sk_worry_1 asserts a focus fact about an eventuality that is only sealed — over-assertion plus a dangling symbol — and the particle itself sits inside the negated quote, which has no polarity carrier.

gaps_confirmed: Direct quotation as a speech-verb complement, including quote-internal first person with no coreference rule for "I" = the speaker.
A wholly negative sealed complement — the registered no-polarity-carrier limitation is written for a negated conjunct among several, not for a complement that is entirely negated.
Cessation ("not ... anymore") inside a seal: the same-symbol Past-plus-denial pair is inexpressible there.
A psych verb with a prepositional object ("worry about that") — Stimulus versus the preposition-named oblique is undetermined, since the prepositional-verb rule names only the direct-object roles.
new_gaps: Applying the leave-it-out limitation to a wholly negative complement empties the attitude of its Theme entirely: nothing in the instruction set says whether an attitude event should still be emitted when its complement is unexpressible, or how a question about it could ever bind.
A focus particle inside a sealed complement has no anchor: focus atoms take an eventuality argument, and every eventuality of the complement lives inside the seal.
repair_summary: The sealed positive worry bundle (say_theme) is removed entirely — the complement is wholly negated and has no polarity carrier, so nothing of it is expressible, which also removes the unmarked-versus-Past tense error. (Member sk_thing_1 thing), the demonstrative's typing, is kept at top level as a projected definite. (Even worry sk_worry_1) is removed with its anchor.
notes: What survives is the matrix report — the fielder said something, at a past time — plus the projected referent of "that"; the content of the quote is left unrecorded rather than recorded backwards. The matrix NP (center_fielder with its fielder genus, the 38-year-old measure on the old scale) is untouched.
